edges.notes: Registry protocol moves OCI image manifests, indexes, configs, and layer blobs defined by the image spec.
Engine and registry clients push/pull using distribution-class HTTP APIs.
Image pull and push paths use registry HTTP semantics compatible with OCI distribution.
kubelet/CRI stacks pull images from registries implementing distribution-compatible APIs.
Podman pushes and pulls images from OCI-compatible registries per documented workflows.
CRI-O pulls container images from registries using distribution-class HTTP behavior.
BuildKit pushes built images to OCI-compatible registries using distribution-class HTTP APIs for manifests and blobs.
Helm can use OCI registries for chart storage and push/pull using distribution-class HTTP semantics.
Flux image automation and registry-facing controllers interact with distribution-class HTTP APIs.
Argo CD pulls charts and images from OCI-compatible registries using distribution-class HTTP semantics.
